scripts.text:
[Boshuu]
I'm the best craftsman out of what people call the Three Craftsmen of Ninja Tools.
They call me Murata Boshuu.
scripts.translation:
[波修]
在所謂的“忍者工具三匠”中，我可是最出色的工匠。
人們都叫我村田波修。

scripts.text:
[Boshuu]
I know how to create any armor and shield of the eastern world, and my shields are considered the best there is.
scripts.translation:
[波修]
我會製作東方世界所有的鎧甲和盾牌，而我的盾牌更是被公認為天下第一。

scripts.text:
[Boshuu]
But seeing how you are an outsider...
Looks like I have no business with you.
Ehem~
scripts.translation:
[波修]
不過，看你像是個外鄉人......看來我跟你沒什麼生意可做。
咳~

scripts.text:
[Boshuu]
I make the best shields for Ninjas of all ages,
But even I have some minimum requirements
scripts.translation:
[波修]
我製作過歷代忍者使用的頂級盾牌。
不過即便是我，也有最低的要求。

scripts.text:
[Boshuu]
It looks like what you need isn't a shield, but more levels.
Come back after you've grown a bit more.
scripts.translation:
[波修]
看來你需要的不是盾牌，而是更多的等級。
等你再成長一些，再來找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Boshuu]
I'm the best craftsman out of what people call the Three Craftsmen of Ninja Tools.
They call me Murata Boshuu.
scripts.translation:
[波修]
在所謂的“忍者工具三匠”中，我可是最出色的工匠。
人們都叫我村田波修。

scripts.text:
[Boshuu]
They say it's three craftsmen, but the other two are probably scammers.
There's not a single craftsman better than I for ninjas in this world.
scripts.translation:
[波修]
雖然說是“三匠”，但另外兩個多半是騙子。
這世上沒有比我更懂忍者的工匠了。

scripts.text:
[Boshuu]
I know how to make all the eastern armor and shield.
scripts.translation:
[波修]
我會製作東方所有的鎧甲和盾牌。

scripts.text:
[Boshuu]
Because the armor I'd create was so superior and defensive, when two people battle wearing armor made by me, no one can win!
scripts.translation:
[波修]
我做的鎧甲堅固無比，防禦力極強。兩個人都穿著我做的鎧甲交手，誰也贏不了！

scripts.text:
[Boshuu]
For that reason, I no longer make any armor.
I'm only collecting armors nowadays, just to make sure my skills do not go to waste..
scripts.translation:
[波修]
因此，我不再製作鎧甲了。
如今我只收集鎧甲，免得自己的手藝荒廢......

scripts.text:
[Boshuu]
But I feel so bored nowadays.
scripts.translation:
[波修]
不過，我最近感到很無聊。

scripts.text:
[Boshuu]
Now that I only collect armor, I feel like the creative flame within me is dying out.
scripts.translation:
[波修]
既然現在只是收集鎧甲，我感覺我內心的創造之火正在熄滅。

scripts.text:
[Boshuu]
From what I heard, there's an armor overseas which I haven't even heard of.
It was called a... hmm.. what was it called?
scripts.translation:
[波修]
我聽說海外有一種我從未聽說過的鎧甲。
好像叫......嗯......叫什麼來著？

scripts.text:
[Boshuu]
^ff0000Guard[1]^000000? Well, it's a name like that.
I wish to see the real thing myself.
scripts.translation:
[波修]
^ff0000防護盾[1]^000000？名字好像差不多。
我真想親眼看看實物。

scripts.text:
[Boshuu]
But obviously, it's probably worthless compared to the armor I make.
scripts.translation:
[波修]
不過顯而易見，它肯定比不上我製作的鎧甲。

scripts.text:
[Boshuu]
Do me a favor and I'll make you something special.
scripts.translation:
[波修]
幫我個忙，我就給你做點特別的東西。

scripts.text:
[Boshuu]
I'm not sure what I'll do, but I get the feeling I'll feel inspired once I see that armor.
How 'bout it~ Will you find me a ^ff0000Guard[1]^000000?
scripts.translation:
[波修]
我還不確定要做什麼，不過看到那件鎧甲後，我應該就會有靈感。
怎麼樣~願意幫我找一件^ff0000防護盾[1]^000000嗎？

scripts.text: Hmm.. I don't feel like it.
scripts.translation: 嗯...我不想

scripts.text: Very well.
scripts.translation: 好吧

scripts.text:
[Boshuu]
Ah~ What a shame..
You're missing out on an opportunity to get your hands on something made by a genius craftsman like myself...
scripts.translation:
[波修]
啊~真可惜......你錯過了獲得天才工匠親手製作的物品的機會......

scripts.text:
[Boshuu]
Oh, Very well.
Get a move on.
Find the shield called ^ff0000Guard[1]^000000 and bring it to me.
scripts.translation:
[波修]
哦，好吧。
動作快點。
找到那件叫^ff0000防護盾[1]^000000的盾牌，帶給我。

scripts.text:
[Boshuu]
Oh.. so did you bring it?
Show it to me...
Hmmmmm...

[Boshuu]
Oh~ ! I see, it's even possible to slot armor!
scripts.translation:
[波修]
哦~原來如此，竟然還能給盾牌打孔！

scripts.text:
[Boshuu]
Ahh, Now I'm just itching to imitating this armor and making a slot on other armors.
scripts.translation:
[波修]
啊，我現在手癢得很，想照著它的樣子，給其他盾牌也打上插槽。

scripts.text:
[Boshuu]
If you have a regular non-slotted Arm Guard and a slotted Guard, I'll make the non-slotted one slotted at the cost of 10,000 Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[波修]
如果你有一件普通的無插槽手臂防護具和一面帶插槽的防護盾，我可以收取10,000 Zeny，把前者改造成帶插槽的。

scripts.text:
[Boshuu]
How 'bout it? Want to try?
scripts.translation:
[波修]
怎麼樣？想試試嗎？

scripts.text: No thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝

scripts.text: Ok, sounds good.
scripts.translation: 好，聽起來不錯

scripts.text:
[Boshuu]
Hmm, Ok.
I'm so grateful that I was able to see such a rare thing from overseas.
Thanks for everything.
scripts.translation:
[波修]
嗯，好的。
我很感激能看到來自海外的如此稀有的東西。
謝謝你的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Boshuu]
Oh ok.
I can't wait to begin.
If you bring me 1 Arm Guard
1 Slotted Guard, and
10,000 Zeny..
scripts.translation:
[波修]
哦，好。
我已經迫不及待了。
帶來1件手臂防護具、1面帶插槽的防護盾，
再加上10,000 Zeny......

scripts.text:
[Boshuu]
Then I'll slot your slotless Arm Guard.
Come back when you have all the required materials.
scripts.translation:
[波修]
那麼我就會給你的無插槽手臂防護具加上插槽。
等你備齊所有材料後再回來吧。

scripts.text:

Hmm... It looks like you didn't bring me enough materials.
In order to create a Slotted Arm Guard, I need 1 Slotted Guard
1 Arm Guard, and 10,000 Zeny
Come back when you're sure you have everything.
scripts.translation:

scripts.translation:

確認材料齊全後再回來。

scripts.text:

But before I start, I must ask you one more time.
Do you want to give me the materials you've brought and receive a Slotted Arm Guard instead?
scripts.translation:
[波修]
哦，看來你帶齊了材料。
不過開始之前，我最後再確認一次：
你確定要交出這些材料，換取一件帶插槽的手臂防護具嗎？

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text:
[Boshuu]
Ok
Well, if you make up your mind again, come and see me.
scripts.translation:
[波修]
好的。
如果你改變主意了，隨時可以來找我。

scripts.text:
[Boshuu]
All right!
This should only take a second
Bang Clang~  Bang Clang~
scripts.translation:
[波修]
好了！
馬上就能完成。
砰鏗~砰鏗~

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

難以置信！真的是它~！

東方世界所有的鎧甲和盾牌，我都會製作。

scripts.text:

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

但是，如果不製作東西，生活有點無聊。

scripts.text:
[Boshuu]
Since all I do is collect now, I feel like the creative spirit within me is disappearing.
scripts.translation:
[巴修]
如今我只收集盾牌和鎧甲，感覺內心的創造熱情正漸漸消失。

scripts.text:
[Boshuu]
But at the sight of your shield, I feel like my sleeping spirit of creativity has awoken.
scripts.translation:

但看到你的盾牌，我感覺我沉睡的創造精神甦醒了。

scripts.text:

I've learned my craft by sneaking looks over my brothers, so my skill is a little less than them, but many people praise me highly.
scripts.translation:

我偷看哥哥們學會了這門手藝，技術比他們稍遜一籌，不過不少人都誇我手藝不錯。

scripts.text:
[Basshu]
As of now, I've given up making shields and am currently running an antique shop for shields.
I'm researching to see if shields can be enchanted with magic.
scripts.translation:

如今我不再製作盾牌，而是經營一家盾牌古董店。
